/-! Independent mathlib-only absorption experiments. -/
#check_failure Roth.lem6M_lt
#check_failure Roth.lem6M
namespace LemSixM217Independent
noncomputable def formula (p r : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (l : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ((r : ℝ) + 1) ^ (p * l) * l.factorial * B ^ l * 2 ^ (p * l * r)
private lemma factorial_coefficient_le_two_pow_aux (p r₁ l : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ 2 ^ r₁) :
    (r₁ + 1) ^ (p * l) * l.factorial * 2 ^ (p * l * r₁) ≤ 2 ^ ((2 * p + 1) * r₁ * l) := by
  calc
    (r₁ + 1) ^ (p * l) * l.factorial * 2 ^ (p * l * r₁)
        ≤ (2 ^ r₁) ^ (p * l) * (2 ^ r₁) ^ l * 2 ^ (p * l * r₁) := by
          gcongr
          · exact Nat.lt_two_pow_self
          · exact (Nat.factorial_le_pow l).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hl _)
    _ = 2 ^ ((2 * p + 1) * r₁ * l) := by
      rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add, ← pow_add]
      ring_nf

private lemma two_pow_lt_rpow_aux {p r₁ l : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) {δ q : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hlog : (p : ℝ) * (2 * p + 1) / δ ≤ Real.log q) (hlr : 0 < l * r₁) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ ((2 * p + 1) * r₁ * l) < q ^ (δ / p * (l * r₁)) := by
  have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp
  replace hq : 0 < q := zero_lt_one.trans <|
    (Real.log_pos_iff hq).1 <| lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hlog
  have hlog2 : Real.log 2 < 1 := by
    exact (Real.log_lt_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) (by norm_num)).trans_eq
      (by norm_num)
  have h3 : (2 * p + 1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log q * (δ / p) := by
    rw [mul_div_assoc', le_div_iff₀ hp0]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hδ] at hlog
    linarith
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num), Real.rpow_def_of_pos hq,
    Real.exp_lt_exp]
  calc
    Real.log 2 * (((2 * p + 1) * r₁ * l : ℕ) : ℝ)
        = Real.log 2 * (2 * p + 1) * (l * r₁) := by
          push_cast
          ring
    _ < Real.log q * (δ / p) * (l * r₁) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
        ((mul_lt_of_lt_one_left (by positivity) hlog2).trans_le h3) (by exact_mod_cast hlr)
    _ = Real.log q * (δ / p * (l * r₁)) := by ring

theorem realEnvelope {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 < δ) {r₁ : ℕ} {q₁ : ℝ}
    (hq₁nonneg : 0 ≤ q₁)
    (hq₁ : (p : ℝ) * (2 * p + 1) / δ ≤ Real.log q₁) {l : ℕ}
    (hl : 1 ≤ l) (hl' : l ≤ 2 ^ r₁) (hr₁ : 0 < r₁) :
    formula p r₁ (q₁ ^ (δ * r₁)) l < q₁ ^ (δ * (1 + 1 / p) * (l * r₁)) := by
  have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hq1pos : (0 : ℝ) < q₁ := zero_lt_one.trans <|
    (Real.log_pos_iff hq₁nonneg).1 <| lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hq₁
  -- the factors other than `B^l` are at most `2^{(2p+1) r₁ l}`
  have hnatR : ((r₁ : ℝ) + 1) ^ (p * l) * l.factorial * 2 ^ (p * l * r₁) ≤
      2 ^ ((2 * p + 1) * r₁ * l) := by
    exact_mod_cast factorial_coefficient_le_two_pow_aux p r₁ l hl'
  calc
    formula p r₁ (q₁ ^ (δ * r₁)) l = ((r₁ : ℝ) + 1) ^ (p * l) * l.factorial *
        2 ^ (p * l * r₁) * (q₁ ^ (δ * r₁)) ^ l := by
          rw [formula]
          ring
    _ ≤ 2 ^ ((2 * p + 1) * r₁ * l) * (q₁ ^ (δ * r₁)) ^ l :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnatR (by positivity)
    _ < q₁ ^ (δ / p * (l * r₁)) * (q₁ ^ (δ * r₁)) ^ l :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right
        (two_pow_lt_rpow_aux hp hδ0 hq1pos.le hq₁ (Nat.mul_pos (by lia) hr₁)) (by positivity)
    _ = q₁ ^ (δ * (1 + 1 / p) * (l * r₁)) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hq1pos.le, ← Real.rpow_add hq1pos]
      congr 1
      ring
#check @Nat.factorial_le_pow
#check @Nat.lt_two_pow_self
#check @Real.rpow_add
#check @Real.rpow_mul_natCast
#check @Real.log_pos_iff
#check @Real.exp_lt_exp
#check @Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp
#print axioms realEnvelope
end LemSixM217Independent

theorem abstractAbsorb {A C q a b : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hAC : A ≤ C) (hC : C < q ^ b)

  rw [Real.rpow_add hq, Real.rpow_mul_natCast hq.le]
  exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (hAC.trans_lt hC) (by positivity)
